06 / FAQ

Before we begin.

Can we begin with research only?

Yes. A focused research or advisory assignment can be a complete engagement. Scope can grow if the project calls for it.

Can you work with our existing team?

Yes. We can work alongside your internal team, agency or local partner, with responsibilities agreed before the project begins.

How are projects scoped and contracted?

Each engagement starts with a proposal covering scope, team, timeline and fees. Formal contracting and invoicing are handled through an Indonesian legal entity, identified in the proposal.

Can you sign an NDA?

Yes. Let us know before sharing confidential material so the appropriate agreement can be put in place.
